records.question: Top team leaders by equivalent new tickets this year

report.title: Top team leaders by equivalent new tickets this year
report.sql:
SELECT u.name AS team_leader_name, COUNT(pt.id) AS new_ticket_count FROM product_task pt JOIN users u ON pt.assign_team_leader = u.id WHERE pt.created_at >= '2026-01-01' AND pt.created_at <= '2026-12-31' AND pt.is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY u.id, u.name ORDER BY new_ticket_count DESC
LIMIT 500
report.explanation: This query counts new tickets (product_task records) assigned to each team leader during the year 2026. It joins the product_task table with the users table to translate team leader IDs into their display names. The query filters for non-deleted tasks created within the specified date range and groups results by team leader to show the count of new tickets per leader, ordered from highest to lowest.
assumptions: New tickets are defined as product_task records created within the date range
The assign_team_leader field in product_task contains the user ID of the team leader
Only non-deleted tasks (is_deleted = 0) should be counted
Team leader names are stored in the users table
